name: Mimi x Mimi! ~Hatsujou Chuuihou~
source:
Girls suddenly acquired different beast ears. And somehow their behavior also becomes animal-like. It's so irresistible! Miya gets cat habits, Natsuki - dog ones. Will peaceful days ever return?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少女们突然长出了不一样的兽耳。不知怎的，他们的行为也变得像动物一样。实在是太让人无法抗拒了！Miya有猫的习惯，Natsuki有狗的习惯。平静的日子还会回来吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
